mentions.name: Flip Dot Clock Revival
mentions.description: Revives old single 5x7 flip dot display modules by designing custom driver electronics. Measurements were taken with a Fluke multimeter and Claude helped with the circuit design; a breadboard prototype worked and custom PCBs have been ordered. The goal is to restore around 30 modules and build clocks from them to gift to family and friends.
mentions.problem: Existing flip dot display projects found online were too hard for an electronics beginner to follow.
mentions.audience: Family and friends who will receive the clocks as gifts
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on getting some old flip dot displays up and running again, more precise the single 5 x 7 modules that bigger displays are made of.
mentions.author: flomei
